hook.text: When Satya Nadella took over Microsoft, he didn't change the product first. He changed the culture.

buildup.text: Transformational leaders inspire change by appealing to higher values and a shared vision.

discovery.text: They focus on four pillars: idealized influence, inspirational motivation, intellectual stimulation, and individual consideration.

twist.text: Transformation is exhausting. Without transactional basics — clear goals, fair rewards — the vision burns people out.

climax.text: Nadella shifted Microsoft from 'know-it-all' to 'learn-it-all' culture. Revenue tripled in eight years.

punchline.text: Change the mindset and the results follow.

quiz.question: What did Satya Nadella prioritize first at Microsoft?
options: Changing the company's culture from 'know-it-all' to 'learn-it-all'

details.summary: Transformational leadership inspires followers to exceed expectations by appealing to higher ideals and values rather than transactional rewards. Through individualized consideration, intellectual stimulation, inspirational motivation, and idealized influence, these leaders transform both people
details.whyItMatters: Transactional leadership gets compliance. Transformational leadership gets commitment. In knowledge work where creativity and discretionary effort matter, engaging people at a deeper level through purpose and values produces dramatically superior
takeaways: Transformational leaders inspire through vision and values, not just rewards
Four components: individualized consideration, intellectual stimulation, inspiration, influence
Research shows transformational leadership produces higher performance and satisfaction

faq.question: What are the four components of transformational leadership?
faq.answer: Idealized influence means modeling the behavior you expect. Inspirational motivation means articulating a compelling vision. Intellectual stimulation means challenging assumptions and encouraging creativity.

faq.question: Can transformational leadership be learned or is it innate?
faq.answer: It can be developed through practice. Learn to articulate vision compellingly. Practice empathy and individualized attention. Challenge your team's thinking with provocative questions. Model the values you espouse.
